entries.rationale: The pose preserves the literal contrast and leaves dignity versus mockery open, as the final interpretation does.
entries.observed: A seated man touches his moustache while looking self-assured above a plain plate of rice.

entries.observed_visual_details: Two white wading birds face one another and their reflections in still water.
entries.rationale: The paired self-appraisal fits mutual admiration without inventing ugliness, deceit, or a human origin story.
entries.observed: Two white wading birds face one another and their reflections in still water.

entries.observed_visual_details: Three people prepare a ground mixture on a slab beside a large cooking pot and other equipment.
entries.rationale: The imagined smaller preparation beside a larger undertaking fits the comparison without asserting the unstated purpose or outcome.
entries.observed: Three people prepare a ground mixture on a slab beside a large cooking pot and other equipment.

entries.observed_visual_details: Two people hold hands while stepping between rocks in shallow water.
entries.rationale: Friendship and physical footing are joined clearly in an imagined crossing; no universal safety claim is depicted.
entries.observed: Two people hold hands while stepping between rocks in shallow water.

entries.observed_visual_details: A person holds out an iron tool head to a traveller carrying a hammer and tongs.
entries.rationale: The encounter becomes a request for skilled work, without showing acceptance or a completed outcome. The specific implement is an imagined prop.
entries.observed: A person holds out an iron tool head to a traveller carrying a hammer and tongs.

entries.observed_visual_details: A young person presents a field-and-water diagram to a group while an older person rests a hand on his shoulder.
entries.rationale: The gathering combines received backing and capacity to help others without pretending to count eighty or excluding people without fathers.
entries.observed: A young person presents a field-and-water diagram to a group while an older person rests a hand on his shoulder.

entries.observed_visual_details: A small bird perches calmly beside a hanging woven nest, with motion strokes and windblown leaves.
entries.rationale: The swaying nest and untroubled bird carry the rhetorical image, not a guarantee that nests survive every wind.
entries.observed: A small bird perches calmly beside a hanging woven nest, with motion strokes and windblown leaves.

entries.observed_visual_details: Three successive positions of the same walker show his legs progressively deeper in soft ground.
entries.rationale: The repeated character and increasing depth make a clear sequence of worsening conditions. The imagined ground supplies a setting without assigning blame or denying recovery.
entries.observed: Three successive positions of the same walker show his legs progressively deeper in soft ground.

entries.observed_visual_details: A person partly submerged in water reaches toward a thin floating straw; all tones are neutral gray.
entries.rationale: The disproportion between danger and tiny hoped-for support is clear. The added imagined reach does not promise rescue and the corrected image is monochrome.
entries.observed: A person partly submerged in water reaches toward a thin floating straw; all tones are neutral gray.

entries.observed_visual_details: A man greets a younger visitor with joined hands, with a smiling woman between them.
entries.rationale: The imagined family-linked greeting fits the kinship relation without claiming a mandatory custom or coercion.
entries.observed: A man greets a younger visitor with joined hands, with a smiling woman between them.

entries.observed_visual_details: A robed bearded visitor holds a bowl while a person at a doorway drops grain into it.
entries.rationale: Visible garb and the response of alms are clear; neither expression nor composition implies fraud or an insincere disguise.
entries.observed: A robed bearded visitor holds a bowl while a person at a doorway drops grain into it.

entries.observed_visual_details: A traveller rests beneath a tree with a walking stick and bag, enjoying a mango slice beside more fruit.
entries.rationale: Enjoyment of available fruit fits hunger changing appreciation. The image does not identify the fruit as rotten or imply that sourness has become sweetness.
entries.observed: A traveller rests beneath a tree with a walking stick and bag, enjoying a mango slice beside more fruit.

entries.observed_visual_details: A person holding a tied bundle stands at an open doorway with one hand on the door; a chipped stone bowl rests nearby.
entries.rationale: As the caption explicitly says imagined departure, this is a compatible application of refusal and the risk of losing shelter. Incidental gender does not establish a daughter-in-law speaker or origin; the picture does not claim the primary passage includes blows, and need not illustrate every clause or variant.
entries.observed: A person holding a tied bundle stands at an open doorway with one hand on the door; a chipped stone bowl rests nearby.
